# TwelveLabs

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 6 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A paper video-intelligence marketing site: Milling Duplex headlines on #f4f3f3, ink pills, a chartreuse New badge, and a signed-out Auth0 login on auth.twelvelabs.io.

Captured 2026-11-19, Public marketing plus signed-out login on auth.twelvelabs.io. Email was entered. Password was not typed. Google was not followed. HubSpot contact form and reCAPTCHA were not filled. No card was entered. No API key was created.. Themes: light.

TwelveLabs (twelvelabs.io) is a video intelligence platform. This package records the public marketing site and the signed-out login on auth.twelvelabs.io, measured on 2026-11-19 from a live T3 preview tab. The email field was left blank.  The next step asked for a password and that field was not filled. Google was not followed. The contact form is a HubSpot iframe with reCAPTCHA and was not filled. No card was entered. No API key was created.

The live CSS viewport was 1169 by 731 at devicePixelRatio 2. Marketing pages paint a paper page (`#f4f3f3`) and ink text (`#1d1c1b`) in Milling Duplex 1mm. `prefers-color-scheme` was dark and the pages did not switch.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Marketing type computes as Milling Duplex 1mm, with a placeholder family behind it. The login headline computes as Milling. Login UI computes as Geist, then system sans. Geist is on the marketing `document.fonts` list and was unloaded there. The body of the marketing page computed as `sans-serif`. Font files were not downloaded. Licences were not read.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The violet Framer token `#673ae4` is declared and was not painted on the pages read. Do not treat it as the button colour. The filled actions use ink.

Six Framer tokens have a `prefers-color-scheme: dark` override. The live page stayed on `#f4f3f3` while the media query matched dark. Those overrides are recorded in [raw/computed.json](raw/computed.json) and are not a dark theme set.

The inverse marketing button's label colour was not read apart from the anchor's default `rgb(0, 0, 238)`. The login Continue label `#f4f4f4` is the inverse text that was actually read.

Milling Duplex 1mm is a commercial face. The tokens name it. This package does not ship the font file.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the paper page and ink type.** The public pages sit on `#f4f3f3` with `#1d1c1b` Milling text. Evidence is the pricing h1 reading in [raw/computed.json](raw/computed.json).
- **Use a paper pill for the hero primary and an ink pill for the selected plan.** Home Try Free is 18px radius on paper. Pricing Choose Plus is 14px radius on ink. Evidence is the same readings file.
- **Keep login on auth.twelvelabs.io as an email step, then a password step.** The card is a translucent white 80px radius. Evidence is the login readings.
- **Use chartreuse only for the small New badge.** `#dae971` was read on that label, not as a page accent.
- **Do not invent a 1440 screenshot.** The CSS viewport was 1169 by 731, and screenshot frames failed.
